{"people":[{"name":"Tom","role":"rep, account executive","side":"us"},{"name":"Raj","role":"CTO, ran the RFP","side":"customer"},{"name":"Angela","role":"COO","side":"customer"},{"name":"Bev","role":"head of store operations","side":"customer"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"ecommerce lead","side":"customer"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"solutions engineer, attended store ops workshop","side":"us"}],
"competitors":["Adyen"],
"incumbent":null,
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their COO, Angela, apparently stood in a store on December 27th watching the returns queue.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Secondhand trigger story, hedged with 'apparently'."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"The store couldn't see the online order","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Describes the returns problem that started the evaluation."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"they'd just launched a loyalty program that was supposed to work everywhere and didn't","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Second pain point: loyalty split across two customer records."},
{"id":"E4","turn":4,"excerpt":"The CTO, Raj. He ran the RFP, he was my contact the whole way.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep names Raj as decider; contradicted later."},
{"id":"E5","turn":6,"excerpt":"they came in with a retail team, people who'd done store rollouts","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj (customer, reported by Tom)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor pitch, relayed indirectly, not verbatim."},
{"id":"E6","turn":6,"excerpt":"they talked about one platform for the tills and the website, on one contract","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj (customer, reported by Tom)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","message"],"note":"Competitor offered one platform and one contract."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"And they named retailers Angela knew.","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj (customer, reported by Tom)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor used references Angela recognized."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"I wasn't there.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep was absent; all competitor detail is secondhand."},
{"id":"E9","turn":8,"excerpt":"Before, it was all web. Conversion, checkout, wallets. After, it was stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Customer questions shifted from web to stores after the competitor meeting."},
{"id":"E10","turn":8,"excerpt":"Raj forwarded me a list of 14 questions and 11 of them were about stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Store questions dominated the customer's list."},
{"id":"E11","turn":8,"excerpt":"How do you roll out 120 stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"customer (question list forwarded by Raj)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Store count of 120 is a concrete rollout requirement."},
{"id":"E12","turn":10,"excerpt":"Reaction: the online checkout demo. Their ecommerce lead loved it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Web demo landed well with the ecommerce lead."},
{"id":"E13","turn":10,"excerpt":"Silence: the unified commerce part.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Our unified commerce pitch got no reaction."},
{"id":"E14","turn":10,"excerpt":"Online and in-store on one platform, the line between them has pretty much disappeared.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Our slide wording; rep's pitch line."},
{"id":"E15","turn":10,"excerpt":"that's a diagram.","label":"quote","speaker":"Bev (customer, head of store operations)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Bev dismissed the unified commerce slide as abstract."},
{"id":"E16","turn":10,"excerpt":"Then she asked how a return works. Step by step. At the till.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Bev's follow-up asked for the in-store return flow."},
{"id":"E17","turn":12,"excerpt":"I described it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Answer to what he said about the return flow; evasive."},
{"id":"E18","turn":14,"excerpt":"They asked for a half day on stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","trigger"],"note":"Store ops workshop request, the point where the rep felt the loss."},
{"id":"E19","turn":14,"excerpt":"They had six people from store operations.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer attendance at the workshop."},
{"id":"E20","turn":14,"excerpt":"Nobody on our side had run a store rollout.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Our team lacked store rollout experience; competitor had it."},
{"id":"E21","turn":14,"excerpt":"When Bev asked who does the installs, I said we'd bring in a partner.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Install answer relied on an unnamed partner."},
{"id":"E22","turn":14,"excerpt":"She wrote something down and didn't ask another question.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Bev's reaction to the partner answer."},
{"id":"E23","turn":14,"excerpt":"I knew on the drive home.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","outcome"],"note":"Rep's own read on when the deal was lost."},
{"id":"E24","turn":14,"excerpt":"Right before that, honestly, we were ahead. Raj said so. We'd won the web side.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep's view of partial win; Raj's view reported secondhand."},
{"id":"E25","turn":16,"excerpt":"Angela's team. Stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","decider"],"note":"Angela's team, not Raj, requested the store workshop."},
{"id":"E26","turn":18,"excerpt":"Angela.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep says Angela signed with Adyen."},
{"id":"E27","turn":20,"excerpt":"Probably Angela.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Hedged decider answer; conflicts with Raj as decider."},
{"id":"E28","turn":20,"excerpt":"Raj wanted us. I think. He told me he did.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Raj's preference is rep's belief, reported secondhand."},
{"id":"E29","turn":22,"excerpt":"Once. The kickoff.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep met Angela only once, at kickoff."},
{"id":"E30","turn":24,"excerpt":"We sent a case study.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Fashion retailer case study, stores and online."},
{"id":"E31","turn":24,"excerpt":"can I talk to them?","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela (customer, COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Angela wanted a reference call we could not arrange."},
{"id":"E32","turn":24,"excerpt":"we couldn't set up a call in time.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Reference call missed; no call in time."},
{"id":"E33","turn":24,"excerpt":"They wanted to watch an online order get returned at a store till, live. We described it. We never showed it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer asked for a live demo; we only described it."},
{"id":"E34","turn":26,"excerpt":"One system for the tills and the website.","label":"quote","speaker":"Bev (customer, head of store operations)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Bev's own framing of the need."},
{"id":"E35","turn":26,"excerpt":"I don't want two vendors pointing at each other.","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela (customer, COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Angela's vendor-accountability concern."},
{"id":"E36","turn":26,"excerpt":"one customer, one basket.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (speaker not named)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer phrasing for unified commerce."},
{"id":"E37","turn":26,"excerpt":"They never said \"unified commerce.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer never used our category term."},
{"id":"E38","turn":26,"excerpt":"We kept saying \"in-person payments\" and \"point of sale.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our terms, which the customer did not use."},
{"id":"E39","turn":26,"excerpt":"the tills.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (speaker not named)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's term for point-of-sale hardware."},
{"id":"E40","turn":28,"excerpt":"I think we had the better product online. I still think that.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Tom (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","outcome"],"note":"Rep's product opinion; web strength, not the decision driver."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E4","E27"],"what":"Rep first names Raj as the decider, then says 'Probably Angela' when asked who made the final call."},
{"evidence":["E28","E26"],"what":"Rep says Raj wanted us, yet Angela signed with Adyen; the rep's account of the decider is unresolved."},
{"evidence":["E29","E31"],"what":"Rep says they met Angela only once, at kickoff, yet reports her direct words in later requests and comments."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"What did you say?","turn":12,"what":"Answered 'I described it.' without saying what was described when the customer asked about the in-store return flow."},
{"question":"So who made the final call?","turn":20,"what":"Hedged with 'Probably Angela', then 'Raj wanted us. I think.', contradicting the earlier decider answer."}
],
"skipped":["decided"],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"One system for the tills and the website.","ours":"unified commerce","evidence":["E34","E37"]},
{"theirs":"the tills","ours":"point of sale","evidence":["E39","E38"]},
{"theirs":"I don't want two vendors pointing at each other.","ours":"we'd bring in a partner","evidence":["E35","E21"]},
{"theirs":"one customer, one basket.","ours":"Online and in-store on one platform","evidence":["E36","E14"]},
{"theirs":"that's a diagram.","ours":"Online and in-store on one platform, the line between them has pretty much disappeared.","evidence":["E15","E14"]},
{"theirs":"can I talk to them?","ours":"We sent a case study.","evidence":["E31","E30"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E26"],"what":"Rep says Angela signed with Adyen, indicating the deal went to the competitor (loss implied, not stated as 'lost')."},
{"evidence":["E24"],"what":"Rep says we were ahead and had 'won the web side', suggesting only part of the business was in play or won."},
{"evidence":["E23"],"what":"Rep says they knew the deal was lost on the drive home after the store ops workshop."},
{"evidence":["E28"],"what":"Rep reports Raj wanted us, unverified and in conflict with the signing outcome."}
]}
